#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/user/workspace/repo
dir=$(dirname "$GYM_TASK")
base=http://127.0.0.1:7789
cleanup() {
  curl -fsS "$base/state" > "$dir/cleanup-card.json" || true
  curl -fsS "$base/events" > "$dir/cleanup-events.json" || true
  amp orb service stop clyde9-ordered-body
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 143' TERM INT
# Outside the gym's kill group: the body remains alive while serve stops,
# like deploy/entrypoint's planner-before-body shutdown.
amp orb service start clyde9-ordered-body --cwd "$root/body" --port 7789 --command 'env MC_HOST=127.0.0.1 MC_PORT=25567 MC_USERNAME=clyde BODY_LISTEN_HOST=127.0.0.1 BODY_LISTEN_PORT=7789 node --import tsx src/index.ts'
for _ in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null "$base/state" 2>/dev/null && break || sleep 1; done
until [ -e "$GYM_READY" ]; do sleep 0.2; done
node /tmp/clyde9-player.mjs &
"$root/gym/.bin/clyde" serve --body "$base" --rcon "$GYM_RCON_ADDR" \
